Both sides agree; high is right. Close 8:4/8:5: inside, Dan.8.4 ends on the ram doing his will and growing great; across, Dan.8.5 opens on a first-person periphrastic clause and the behold particle. The 8:4/8:5 seam is preferred because it divides the ram from the goat and leaves two rows of legal length, not because it is the only seam with a device. State it as a weighing, with its tier.
